name: ZPS_CLIENT_USAGE_DETAILS
description: This table stores the detailed usage data(Action and Page View counts) of Office365 Client for Oracle Engagement Cloud. The data stored in this table would be used to analyze the Client usage.

columns.name: USAGE_DETAILS_ID
columns.description: Primary key of the table

columns.name: USAGE_ID
columns.description: Foreign key to table ZPS_CLIENT_USAGES

columns.name: OBJECT_NAME
columns.description: Name of OEC Object for which we track the Actions and Page Views.

columns.name: ACTION_TYPE
columns.description: Action Type of the Object, this field is to store the custom action types.

columns.name: VIEW_TYPE
columns.description: View  Type of the Object, this field is to store the custom view types.

columns.name: ACT_READ_COUNT
columns.description: Number of Read Actions per Object

columns.name: ACT_READ_SUCCESS_COUNT
columns.description: Number of Successful Read Actions per Object

columns.name: ACT_CREATE_COUNT
columns.description: Number of Create Actions per Object

columns.name: ACT_CREATE_SUCCESS_COUNT
columns.description: Number of Successful Create Actions per Object

columns.name: ACT_EDIT_COUNT
columns.description: Number of Update Actions per Object

columns.name: ACT_EDIT_SUCCESS_COUNT
columns.description: Number of Successful Update Actions per Object

columns.name: ACT_DELETE_COUNT
columns.description: Number of Delete Actions per Object

columns.name: ACT_DELETE_SUCCESS_COUNT
columns.description: Number of Successful Delete Actions per Object

columns.name: PV_LIST_COUNT
columns.description: Number of list page view count per Object

columns.name: PV_DETAIL_COUNT
columns.description: Number of Detail page view count per Object

columns.name: PV_EDIT_COUNT
columns.description: Number of Edit page view count per Object

columns.name: PV_PICKER_COUNT
columns.description: Number of Picker page view count per Object

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.
